title: Streaming telemetry proxy: version fallback + data-fidelity audit
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Introduce a streaming telemetry proxy layer that performs runtime schema negotiation, graceful fallback to older telemetry versions, and an audit-capable trail to validate data fidelity during SDK/CLI/API rollouts. This ticket captures design decisions, compatibility heuristics, backfill strategy for historical events, and an automated simulator to validate cross-version invariants.
updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff with PM and Observability. Agreed scope: proxy + audit log + simulator; defer CLI-side migration helpers to a follow-up.

2026-03-02: Spike complete — prototype proxy using envoy filter + Lua for lightweight header-based version negotiation. Found performance overhead ~= 0.8ms per request at 95th percentile; acceptable for console telemetry but needs perf test under 10k rps.

2026-03-05: Design review with Runtime team. Decision: use schema-version hint header from SDK; if absent, fall back to agent-capability probe. Avoid client-side blocking upgrades; proxy should accept 3 recent schema versions by default.
2026-03-07: Added backfill plan for historical analytic events: use offline transformer to rehydrate legacy records into v3 canonical shape, tag transformed rows with provenance metadata.
2026-03-10: Security review pre-check completed — proxy will redact sensitive fields before audit export. Formal security sign-off required before production rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Proxy accepts telemetry payloads tagged with schema v1, v2, v3 and routes them to the ingestion topic without data loss.
When an unknown/newer schema is received, proxy emits a metrics counter and routes to quarantine topic for manual/automated processing.
Backfill pipeline can normalize a sampled 7-day window of historical events into v3 and produce a reconciliation report with mismatches under 0.5%.
Simulator can run SDK/CLI/API payloads through the negotiation logic and assert parity between direct ingestion and proxy-processed ingestion for core analytics fields.
End-to-end latency overhead of proxy under expected load (target 5k rps) remains below 1.5ms p95 additional latency.
Security requirements met: PII fields are redacted before audit exports and access controls are applied to quarantine topic.
migration_steps: 1) Deploy proxy into staging alongside existing ingestion gateway in passthrough mode for 48h.
2) Enable negotiation and tag incoming events with interpreted schema version; send copies to quarantine and main topic for comparison (dual-write).
3) Run simulator against dual-write topics for 72h and produce reconciliation report.
4) Run backfill on a rolling 7-day sample and validate that transformed rows match expected canonical v3 fields; iterate mapping for edge cases.
5) Gradually enable proxy for 10% -> 50% -> 100% of traffic with rollback gates based on fidelity metrics and latency budget.
6) Decommission old ad-hoc ingestion paths after 14 days of stable parity metrics.
